question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $975$ and $221.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}975 & = & 221(4) & + & 91 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 221 & = & 91(2) & + & 39 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 91 & = & 39(2) & + & 13 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 39 & = & 13(3) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $13.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $975$ and $221$ is $13.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(975,221)=13.
$$
